stage1.impression: A plausible, well-composed deep view of a timber-and-concrete bar with a good sense of depth, but it still reads as CG. The floor is blotchy, the Orbs read as cold white golf balls, the big pendant sphere reads as a black wire cage rather than thick cast acrylic, and the speakers at the far end are small grey-white boxes, so no hero lands at a glance. It reads more as a generic moody bar than a specific place: the record wall and banquette help, but the altar and the centrepiece, which would make it specific, do not read.

blocking_9: Mother EARF must read as thick smoked cast acrylic (glowing polished disc edges, see-through tint), not a black wire cage; region [610,30,870,270] currently lum_median 8.8 with crush 12%
The altar pair must read as tinted acrylic cabinets with light through them, region [510,330,580,440] lum_median >= 45 (now 24.1), not as white faces under a hot spot
Concrete floor without mottled CG blotches, and darker than the bar face it sits under
Orbs must glow warm and smoked (r_median clearly above b_median), not neutral white (now 188/189/185)
Banquette and right foreground must hold detail (crush_pct < 5 in [940,520,1200,800], now 10.7)
Frosted screens on the right wall must glow evenly as lit panels, not read as blurry grey canvases
The frame needs a lens and viewpoint that make the altar large enough to be the destination of the picture

defects.what: Mother EARF reads as a black wire or mesh cage: near-black discs with thin line edges, no glow at the polished edges, no visible tint or thickness
Mother EARF's shadow on the concrete reads as a window-mullion light pattern, not as disc shadows
Altar speakers read as small white/grey boxes with bright driver faces (p95 238); cabinets show no tint and no light through the acrylic; the haze cones from the altar spots are visible as streaks
Back-bar speaker reads as a grey framed panel, not as tinted acrylic
Concrete floor is mottled with puddle-like patches and too bright (median 59.6) for a night room, so it reads as CG polish
Orb table lamps read as neutral white balls (RGB 188/189/185), cold against the 2400 K room, with no smoked tint
Banquette crushed (median 14.4, crush 10.7%); the seat backs merge into black
Frosted screens read as blurry grey prints in frames, not glowing panels; slight violet cast against the warm wall
Concrete wall has an olive-yellow cast and few board marks or tie holes at 1:1
Counter top reads milky white (median 145) rather than zinc with a dark patina
Rows of identical stools and chairs repeated without variation or anything out of place

changes.problem: The centrepiece reads as a black cage because nothing lights the cast acrylic's edges or through its body.

evidence.measured: lum_median 8.8, p95 37.3, crush_pct 12.1; at 1:1 the discs show as thin dark lines with no edge glow

change.setting: Mother EARF: one hard spot 60.0 W, cone 34.0 deg (plus a new low grazing light)
change.from: 60 W hard spot from [6.24, 2.75, 3.32], discs unlit
change.to: hard spot 120 W, cone 28 deg; add a narrow 2700 K spot of about 20 W from the ceiling directly above the globe, aimed down the disc planes so the 25 mm polished edges catch and pipe light

changes.expected: Disc edges glow as bright warm lines, the smoked body reads see-through dark grey-brown, and the shadow on the wall becomes stronger and readable as overlapping discs

changes.problem: The altar pair is overlit on the faces and dark in the cabinets, so the speakers read as white boxes and the tinted acrylic never shows.

evidence.measured: lum_median 24.1 against the target of 45 or more; the face at [520,380,560,430] p95 238 and neutral RGB 117/113/112

change.setting: lamps: the altar 2 x spot 300.0 W, cone 22.0 deg; on each Ember speaker 4 x area 1.0 W/m2
change.from: 300 W at 22 deg; speaker area lamps 1.0 W/m2
change.to: altar spots 160 W at 32 deg; speaker area lamps 4.0 W/m2 placed behind or under the cabinets so light passes through the acrylic

changes.expected: Cabinets glow from within with visible smoked tint and white batts; faces no longer hot; the altar becomes the brightest destination at the end of the room

changes.problem: The concrete floor is mottled and too bright, which makes it look like a CG polished floor.

evidence.measured: lum_median 59.6, brighter than the frame median of 36; puddle-like blotches seen at 1:1

change.setting: the floor's polish and the concrete's tone
change.to: honed matte (roughness about 0.55), tone one stop darker, and the large-scale blotch texture reduced to a faint aggregate and trowel variation

changes.expected: Floor sits darker than the furniture with soft pools under the Orbs and the Domes instead of a sheen everywhere

changes.problem: The Orbs read as cold white golf balls, out of the 2400 K room and not smoked.

change.to: liner glow tinted 2400 K and reduced to about 0.006, lamp 0.25 W so that more light falls on the table than on the globe face

changes.expected: Orbs glow warm amber-grey through the smoke and throw a warm pool on each table top

changes.problem: The banquette in the right foreground is crushed and loses its upholstery.

change.setting: candles 2 x point 3.0 W, 1900 K (add a votive on the near banquette table) and the Domes' downlights
change.from: no source near the near banquette
change.to: a votive at 3 W on the nearest banquette table; the Domes' downlights 50 W to 60 W

changes.expected: Seat backs and the fluted panel hold detail with warm low light

changes.problem: The frosted screens read as dull grey canvases, not lit frosted acrylic.

evidence.measured: lum_median 76.7, p95 98, lum_range 73.6, and a violet tint (b 74 over g 73)

change.to: 0.07, with the images warmed to about 3000 K

changes.expected: Screens glow evenly and softly as backlit frosted panels, a quiet second light level along the right wall

changes.problem: An overall olive-sepia wash makes the concrete look yellow-green rather than warm grey.

evidence.measured: RGB median 76/61/54, the green high relative to blue over a grey material

changes.expected: Concrete reads warm grey under tungsten, and the timber stays amber

changes.problem: At 28 mm from the door the altar pair is about 40 px wide and the room's specifics are tiny; the picture has no hero.

evidence.measured: the altar zone fills about 5% of the frame, lum_median 25.7

change.to: 40 mm at [2.6, 1.6, 1.25], still aimed at [16.5, 3.2, 1.2], keeping Mother EARF in the upper right third

changes.expected: The altar pair is about twice as large, the room is compressed and more intimate, and the globe still frames the top

out_of_scope.request: Give the altar and back-bar speakers a visibly saturated tint
out_of_scope.why: The Smoke configuration fixes their colour; only their lighting can change

out_of_scope.request: Vary the identical stools and chairs
out_of_scope.why: The seats are fixed by the room's design; only props such as a coat or a bag can break the repetition
